# Codependence

> Codependence updates dependencies across Node, Python, Go, Rust, Docker, GitHub Actions, and Helm. Use the CLI to preview and apply changes locally, or configure the GitHub Action to open scheduled update pull requests.

Install as a root devDependency (`npm install codependence --save-dev`) and run `codependence` to check targets or `codependence --update` to apply policy. `codependence init actions` generates split scheduled workflows per manager area, each maintaining a stable pull-request branch such as `update-dependencies/docker`.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/introduction): Pin lodash and update the other packages and Docker images in one pull request

## Usage

- [CLI](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/cli): Commands, flags, and `.codependencerc` configuration
- [Node.js API](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/node): Check manifests, inspect version diffs, and handle failures with checkFiles
- [GitHub Action](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/github-action): Create small dependency update pull requests by manager
- [Usage Examples](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/usage): Reproduce a failing npm check and a Docker base image update
- [Supported languages](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/supported-languages/): Supported files and working examples for Python, Go, and Rust
- [Recipes](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/recipes): Check pnpm and Go manifests or save a JSON report

## Optional

- [Why use Codependence?](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/why-use-codependence): When versions need a policy, not just occasional update PRs
- [Why not use Codependence?](https://jeffry.in/codependence/docs/why-not-use-codependence): When Dependabot or Renovate already cover your workflow
- [README](https://github.com/yowainwright/codependence/blob/main/README.md): Repository overview and quick start
- [GitHub Action guide](https://github.com/yowainwright/codependence/blob/main/.github/ACTION.md): Full Action inputs, lockfile policy, and PAT permissions
